title: DPIIT Issues Updated SOP for Fast-Track Land-Border FDI Clearances within 60 Days
summary: DPIIT identifies 40 sub-sectors for 60-day expedited FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) clearance, relaxing Press Note 3 (2020) for up to 10% non-controlling Chinese/HK stakes.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 DPIIT Issues Updated SOP for Fast-Track Land-Border FDI Clearances within 60 Days. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: DPIIT updated Press Note 3 guidelines, allowing non-controlling foreign investments with up to 10% Chinese/HK shareholding via automatic route in 40 key manufacturing sub-sectors.
